programme.desc: When the reluctant son of a gangster is summoned home to avenge his father's death, he enlists his father's always-drunk bodyguard to help him out.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A Japanese security agent teams up with a master thief to recover counterfeit USD plates until a U.S. Embassy official betrays them and escapes to Korea with the prize.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: Three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists on dinner together every night, but tensions rises when their girlfriends join the table.

programme.title: Song of Spring
programme.desc: This is a touching story about an 85-year-old mother caring for her 65-year-old daughter with Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: Right-hand man to a Macau tycoon, Zun Fei, is torn between love and justice amid brutal underworld violence and power struggles. When a deadly gamble turns against him, his life hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Fei meets young talent Wai who suffers from a rare disease, and helps Wai find his lost love. Even when they know the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body.

programme.title: Man On the Edge
programme.desc: A triad leader assigns his right-hand man Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business, but Ah Lok is actually an undercover policeman who unveils a shocking political conspiracy.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a successful lawyer. During an investigation into a court case, he meets a girl who triggers his memories of a rainy night, revealing a long-hidden secret from 20 years ago...

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: The highest grossing Chinese movie in Hong Kong history, the story tells of a barrister who swears to prove his client's innocence, going against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong.

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis?

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: After Keung Hang Yu discovers her husband cheating, she's viciously attacked & left for dead. Then she woke up five years earlier, with the power to glimpse the future & a plan for revenge.

programme.desc: A hotshot lawyer uncovers the conspiracy of a small village while defending her estranged mother, who has Alzheimer's disease and accused of killing the attendees at her husband's funeral.

programme.title: Hi-five
programme.desc: Five strangers gain organs and superpowers from a mysterious donor. United by markings, they clash as a team while a cult leader hunts them to steal their powers and achieve immortality.

programme.title: Smugglers
programme.desc: The haenyeos are having trouble with collecting seafood under water because of the newly built factory nearby. To make a living, they started doing smuggling business...

programme.title: A Melody to Remember
programme.desc: Amidst the Korean War in 1952, Lt. Han Sang-ryul formed a choir with the orphaned refugee children in Busan, finding solace and purpose through music, despite the hardships of war.

programme.title: Montage
programme.desc: 5 days before the statute of limitations of a 15-year-old kidnapping case expires, a flower is left anonymously at the crime scene. A few days later, a similar kidnapping takes place.

programme.title: The Tiger
programme.desc: While the Kingdom of Korea is under occupation by the Japanese, an old and experienced hunter is challenged by the hunt of the last tiger in the country.

programme.title: The Hot-blooded
programme.desc: 4 friends gave up on Taekwondo and part ways after being asked to lose on purpose in a trial. Years later, they decided to take on a local gang realizing their hometown is threatened.

programme.title: 4pm
programme.desc: A couple moved to a new house, dreaming of a peaceful country life. But they face a terrifying reality due to their neighbor, who visits them at the same time every day with just silence...

programme.title: 6/45: Lucky Lotto
programme.desc: The excitement of winning a lottery ticket doesn't last long for sergeant Chun-woo as it accidentally ends up crossing the Military Demarcation Line. He must get his act together and find it again!

programme.title: The Girl on a Bulldozer
programme.desc: As the girl seeks truth behind the sudden car accident of her father, anger and despair left her only one option.

programme.title: Killing Romance
programme.desc: As a popular actress has growing discontentment towards her marriage, she begins planning to kill her rich husband with her neighbor.

programme.title: Honeysweet
programme.desc: Chi-ho is a successful product designer. Il-young works in a loan company. They meet at her company when he try to pay his brother's debt. Coincidence brings them to become closer.

programme.desc: Si lelaki sukakan si perempuan, tanpa sedar yang si perempuan itu psiko dan obses dengan cintanya. Cara untuk selamatkan diri hanya dengan jatuh cinta dengan si perempuan semula.

programme.title: Bini Aku Dari...

programme.title: Tebus
programme.desc: Anak perempuan Mikail telah di culik dan untuk menyelamatkan anaknya dia cuba mengimbau kembali sejarah lampau dirinya ketika menyertai kumpulan gangster.

programme.title: Survival 486
programme.desc: Syuhada going hiking to Gunung Tahan with her friends. Unfortunately, she got lost and fell into a deep hole and trapped there for 19 days.

programme.title: Bibik Aku Nak Kahwin

Di saat akhir sebelum syarikat pelancongan Fidie terpaksa ditutup dia mendapat satu tawaran untuk pakej umrah yang berterusan dari sebuah syarikat swasta. Pada mulanya Fidie tidak mahu menerima tawaran itu kerana menyangka Zirra menolongnya.Pemilik syarikat itu datang ke pejabat Fidie. Ternyata bukan Zirra. Fidie kembali bersemangat untuk memajukan syarikatnya.

programme.title: Gostan
programme.desc: Keterujaan seorang lelaki untuk memiliki kenderaan baru menjadi suatu tragedi apabila munculnya visual si mati dari kamera gostan, membawa kepada sebuah misteri kejadian langgar lari.

programme.title: Bib
programme.desc: Bib menghadapi saat-saat akhir pertandingan peringkat negeri tanpa Kak Ton. Fendi tahu, Bib perlukan Kak Ton sebagai pemberi semangat. Bib agak tewas diawal perlawanan. Syamil tidak muncul pada pertandingan itu menimbulkan keresahan Bib.

programme.title: Sabarlah Duhai Hati
programme.desc: Zainal, suami Shima merahsiakan perkahwinan keduanya. Shima mengamuk selepas mengetahuinya, Zainal menceraikan Shima. Ibu Fira, Zalina mengandung lagi, Fira mula tidak sukakan adiknya. Hjh Suhaily kecewa apabila Waiz memutuskan pertunangan dengan anak bongsunya Suraya. 6 tahun kemudian, Zalina melahirkan anak lelaki dinamakan Danish. Fira membuka perniagaan secara online, dia berkawan baik dengan Nazim melalui perniagaan mayanya. Hubungan Fira dengan Dian tidak semesra lalu.

programme.title: Another Love
programme.desc: Setahun berlalu. Leyla telah berpindah, tetapi parut kekal. Suatu hari, dia menerima bungkusan yang mengandungi kalung biasa—kalung Kenan. Sebuah nota berbunyi: "Saya terpaksa menjadi orang lain. Tetapi saya ingat awak."

programme.title: Outbreak
programme.desc: Untuk episod ini, Aina Suzaily sebagai hos akan mencuba aktiviti sukan lasak & ekstrem Longboard dan meliputi segala aspek dari segi sejarah, keselamatan dan kemahiran.

programme.title: Dapur Bujang Western

programme.title: The Teachers Diary
programme.desc: Seorang guru wanita, Ann, meninggalkan diarinya di sebuah sekolah terapung terpencil. Setahun kemudian, Song, seorang bekas ahli gusti yang menjadi guru, ditugaskan ke sekolah sama dan menemui diari tersebut. Melalui catatan Ann, Song mula memahami cabaran dan keindahan menjadi guru, dan perlahan-lahan jatuh cinta kepadanya meskipun mereka tidak pernah bertemu. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang cinta, dedikasi, dan hubungan melalui tulisan.

programme.title: Mr Stalker… Saya Cintakan Awaklah!
programme.desc: Raziq tidak putus asa memujuk Nadine agar kembali kepadanya. Ketika cuba melarikan diri dari Raziq, Nadine terlibat dengan kemalangan jalanraya yang mengakibatkan pemandunya bernama Affan meninggal dunia. Ibu kepada Affan bersumpah untuk tidak memaafkan Nadine di atas kematian Affan. Nadine akhirnya memutuskan untuk membatalkan perkahwinannya dengan Raziq. Bapa Raziq, Syed Fuad marah dan mengancam untuk mengambil tindakan mahkamah terhadap Nadine dan keluarganya.

programme.desc: Aiman, Zita, Zara dan Fina semakin rapat. Ketiga-tiga sahabat cuba memahami perasaan masing-masing terhadap Aiman, tetapi masing-masing menyimpan emosi tersendiri.

programme.title: Sabarlah Duhai Hati
programme.desc: Fira mula goyah apabila Affan terus menunjukkan keikhlasan hatinya, walaupun dia masih keras hati.

Luqman dan Irma tiba, Luqman bertindak memukul Aizat selepas Hanim membuat fitnah kononnya Aizat memukulnya. Dato Amri berjumpa Aizat, dia bersedia membantu Aizat jika perlu. programme.title: Beyond the Spotlight

programme.title: Beyond the Spotlight
programme.desc: Joe Namath grew up in Beaver Falls, Pennsylvania, near Pittsburgh. After his parents' divorce, Joe turned to sports; he was propelled into sports stardom in college and professional football earning the nickname Broadway Joe.

programme.title: Beyond the Spotlight

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: A look at the men and women who've run and, in some cases, won the Oval Office.

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.sub-title: How to Get Away with It
programme.desc: A look at some of history's criminals, con artists, frauds and fakes, from Adam Worth, the 19th-century inspiration for Professor Moriarty, to a jewel thief named Diamond Doris and a count who sold the Eiffel Tower to gullible buyers twice.

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: A look at espionage; meeting spies from Delilah to Roald Dahl and along the way revealing the real model for James Bond.

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: A look at wars that lasted for centuries and others that were over in minutes, as well as the difficulty of ending a war; the possibility of starting a war over almost anything, from an unprovoked invasion to a lost ear, a pastry or a stolen bucket.

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: Throughout history, men and women have dedicated themselves to raking in wealth in the form of old money, new money and blood money; a look at how they got it, spent it and how it affected their happiness, from Robber Barons to Mansa Musa of Mali.

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: Exploring why, from Liz Taylor to Attila the Hun, pain doesn't stop people from looking for love; how love is a driver of history, costing royalty their heads, generals their victories, and many people their sanity.

programme.desc: They tower over urban landscapes, spread across city blocks and span mountainous regions, each a modern marvel of technological innovation. But how are the world's most remarkable superstructures built? This series showcases key aspects, with footage filmed during construction along with CGI to reveal building processes with astonishing detail. Take, for example, the 71,000 seat Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta. The $1.4 billion stadium is hailed as an architectural wonder because of its eight-petal retractable roof.
